issue_request: FHIR-40288 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking to add a Device module landing page that describes how device-related resources work together and can host guidance for device-related tracker items.
initial_application: The source history shows direct application in faf0e6f2ea, which added source/device-module.html, publication registration, hierarchy wiring, module-list wiring, and the original diagram asset. The follow-up 6821c4b5c5 corrected copied Nutrition title/header text to Device.
additional_context: OO minutes on 2025-03-18 record FHIR-40288 as preapplied in PR3413 and approved Persuasive 6-0-0. Current source keeps the page in build/navigation scope through publish.ini, hierarchy.xml, modules-list.html, modules-fragment.html, and an Administration module link. Later page-specific commits refined text, links, use cases, and diagrams without reversing the landing-page decision. The Confluence Device Module project page lists additional device guidance tickets, but those are separate resource/guidance questions and were not needed to decide the seed.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The existing Device module page and its build/navigation wiring satisfy the requested landing-page addition.
